tcs.test_item:
The software shall validate hour (0–23), minute (0–59), second (0–59) before transmission
(confirm the hour is sent in 24 hour form at the lower bound)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Time Hours" to 00 and "Set Time Minutes" to 00
3. Read $DateTmHour$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour2_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The time entry is accepted
3. $DateTmHour$ carries 0 in Hour1_TLM and 0 in Hour2_TLM
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4813930 逐字：minimum value of 0 hours for 12:00 midnight。4813927 明訂以 24h 格式送出。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認

tcs.test_item:
The software shall validate hour (0–23), minute (0–59), second (0–59) before transmission
(confirm a value outside the hour range is treated as invalid by the receiver)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
tcs.input_test_data: PENDING: DR-20 注入越界 $DateTmHour$ 之操作方式
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-20 注入越界 $DateTmHour$（值 24）之操作方式
2. Read the time shown on the IPC display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. An out-of-range $DateTmHour$ is being received
2. The IPC does not display the out-of-range value
tcs.reasoning: 4813930 末句：Any values other than 0 - 23 shall be considered invalid by the receiving module。24 為上界外之第一個值。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall validate hour (0–23), minute (0–59), second (0–59) before transmission
(confirm the receiving module converts the hour using the format signal)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
"Time Format" is set to "12 hrs"
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Time Hours" to 13
3. Read $DateTmHour$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour2_TLM on FD and record it
4. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Set Time Hours" shows 1 PM
3. $DateTmHour$ carries 1 in Hour1_TLM and 3 in Hour2_TLM
4. The HU display shows 1:00 PM
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814009 / 4814010：the receiving module shall convert the hour to be displayed based upon the $DateTmFormat$ signal —— 匯流排恆為 24h，轉換在接收端。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall store, recall, and broadcast time format (12H/24H) across wake cycles
(confirm the last known format is recalled after a wake cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is asleep
"Time Format" was set to "12 hrs" before sleep
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Wake the CAN bus
2. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN bus is awake
2. The HU display shows the time in 12 hour form
tcs.reasoning: 4813972 逐字：When the CAN transitions from sleep to wake, the HU shall recall the last known format and apply this format to the time display。**本條只驗格式之保存與套用，不驗時間值之送出時機**（B-6 界線，該時機屬 008）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall store, recall, and broadcast time format (12H/24H) across wake cycles
(confirm the recalled format is broadcast after a wake cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is asleep
"Time Format" was set to "24 hrs" before sleep
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Wake the CAN bus
2. Read $DateTmFormat$ in TELEMATIC_FD_10.DateTmFormat on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN bus is awake
2. $DateTmFormat$ carries 2 (FORMAT_24H)
tcs.reasoning: 4813974 逐字列出 $DateTmFormat$ = [format type]。值域 2 = FORMAT_24H 取自 LID 表 Format 欄。**不驗時間值之送出**（B-6）。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 407（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall store, recall, and broadcast time format (12H/24H) across wake cycles
(confirm an invalid format value leaves the last known format in use)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The VES screens are powered on
"Time Format" is set to "12 hrs"
tcs.input_test_data: PENDING: DR-20 注入無效 $DateTmFormat$ 之操作方式
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-20 注入無效 $DateTmFormat$（值 5）之操作方式
2. Read the time shown on the VES screen and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. An invalid $DateTmFormat$ is being received
2. The VES screen continues to show the time in 12 hour form
tcs.reasoning: 4813978：Valid signal values shall be [FORMAT_12H or FORMAT_24H]. For all other values, the signal shall be ignored and the VES module shall use the last known format。值 5 = FORMAT_2，在 LID 表值域內但不在 4813978 所列之有效值內。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 407（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall transmit date via TELEMATICS_TIME_DATE and TLM LIDs to IPC
(confirm the date is sent to the instrument cluster on the telematics message)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to 20 / 07 / 2031
3. Read the date shown on the IPC display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. The IPC display shows 20/07/2031
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814019：The HU shall send HU_Date.Info via TELEMATIC_TIME_DATE。**本條不涵蓋 GPS 來源值之送出**（B-5 界線，屬 014）—— 故前置條件明訂 GPS 同步關閉，日期來自手動設定。**五個 TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE_* LID 依 R-TM62 於 Atl-H 無對映，不寫入任何訊號斷言。** **拆分（`21` T4）**：017 之四物件跨兩架構（4814019 為 Atlantis High，其餘三者為 Atlantis Mid）。本條為 **Atlantis High 組**，只引 4814019，以 TELEMATIC_TIME_DATE 與 IPC 顯示值為判準。Atlantis Mid 組之 TLM LID 斷言另立（見同片之 Atl-Mid 條）。

tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814019 之傳送隨來源值變動。**不涵蓋 GPS 來源值**（B-5）。 **拆分（`21` T4）**：017 之四物件跨兩架構（4814019 為 Atlantis High，其餘三者為 Atlantis Mid）。本條為 **Atlantis High 組**，只引 4814019，以 TELEMATIC_TIME_DATE 與 IPC 顯示值為判準。Atlantis Mid 組之 TLM LID 斷言另立（見同片之 Atl-Mid 條）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall transmit date via TELEMATICS_TIME_DATE and TLM LIDs to IPC
(confirm the date is carried on the TLM managed signals)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis Mid architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to 20 / 07 / 2031
3. Read $TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE_Day$ in TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE.Day1_TLM_Master / TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE.Day2_TLM_Master on CAN-B and record it
4. Read $TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE_Month$ in TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE.Month1_TLM_Master / TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE.Month2_TLM_Master on CAN-B and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. $TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE_Day$ carries 2 in Day1_TLM_Master and 0 in Day2_TLM_Master
4. $TLM_MANAGED_TIME_DATE_Month$ carries 0 in Month1_TLM_Master and 7 in Month2_TLM_Master
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814053 / 4814073 / 4814091 為 017 之 Atlantis Mid 物件（R-TM75：其為本專案之另一架構變體，寫真值）。**R-TM62 已撤回**，五個 TLM_MANAGED_* LID 於 Atlantis 欄有值，本組得寫其斷言。日期各欄為 4-bit 數位對。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis (col 16-20) 欄，來源列 2120 / 2123 / 2124（A-TM26 訂正之強制記錄：本組為 Atlantis Mid，故取欄 16-20 而非 26-30）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall transmit date via TELEMATICS_TIME_DATE and TLM LIDs to IPC

tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis Mid architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:

tcs.reasoning: 年份於 TLM 側同為四個 4-bit 數位（LID 表 Format 欄）。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis (col 16-20) 欄，來源列 2120 / 2123 / 2124（A-TM26 訂正之強制記錄：本組為 Atlantis Mid，故取欄 16-20 而非 26-30）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall enable/disable time/date features based on Proxi parameters (Cluster type, GPS, NAV)
(confirm the clock is enabled when the vehicle is configured for it)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is asleep
Proxi Cluster_Display_Type is set to 3 (High Display)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Wake the CAN bus
2. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN bus is awake and the HU reads the Proxi configuration
2. The HU display shows the clock
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4813914：CAN sleep→wake 時 HU 監看 Proxi 並判定車輛是否已組態；4813915：組態後判定時鐘啟用與否。Cluster_Display_Type 之值域取自 data/proxi_atlantis_high.tsv（Atlantis & Atlantis High (col 16-20, Proxi sheet)），**為 PROXI 參數而非 CAN 訊號**，故寫入前置條件而不寫訊號三件組。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall synchronize time/date between HU, IPC, and LTM via TIME_DATE messages
(confirm a time change on the head unit reaches the instrument cluster)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis Mid architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the IPC display and record it
2. Open the "Clock" settings
3. Set "Set Time Hours" to 09 and "Set Time Minutes" to 15
4. Read the time shown on the IPC display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The IPC display shows the starting time
2. The "Clock" settings open
3. The time entry is accepted
4. The IPC display shows 09:15
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 020 之四個引用物件全為 Atlantis Mid（`12` §2.2：Atl-Hi 錨點為零），依 R-TM64 之零真值例外，spec_reference 寫單一佔位，逐項明細入 Remarks。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall synchronize time/date between HU, IPC, and LTM via TIME_DATE messages
(confirm the head unit and the cluster hold the same time after a wake cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis Mid architecture variant
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is asleep
A time has been set on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Wake the CAN bus
2. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
3. Read the time shown on the IPC display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN bus is awake
2. The HU display shows a time value
3. The IPC display shows the same time value as the HU display
tcs.reasoning: 020 之同步在喚醒後之維持。spec_reference 同前條之零真值例外。
